newsitem.title: FRANCE: CADES says sells extra 1.3 bln Ffr of bonds.
newsitem.headline: CADES says sells extra 1.3 bln Ffr of bonds.

text.p: French welfare debt repayment fund
CADES said on Friday it had sold a further 1.313 billion francs
of bonds after Thursday's auction, increasing the total value of
bonds sold to 11.28 billion francs.
Final details of the CADES bond sales are as follows:

NOTE - CADES originally announced it planned to sell 8 to 10 billion francs of CADES bonds in total this week. The total bid cover ratio of the auction was 3.9.

CADES adopted the same system as the Treasury whereby primary dealers not only submit competitive bids at the bond auction, but also have the option, for a limited period after the sale, of buying extra bonds at the average auction price.
